requirement.description: The Const class has incorrect error handling for layout validation. Tests expect specific error messages but get different ones. Additionally, the class lacks proper handling of layout conflicts with attributes.
requirement.contract: 1. The Const class should validate layout types and throw TypeError with message matching r"^Layout of a constant must be a Layout, not <.+?>$" when layout is not a Layout instance. 2. The Const class should validate target values and throw TypeError with message matching r"^Target of a constant must be an int, not <.+?>$" when target is not an integer. 3. The Const class should properly detect and warn about layout conflicts with attributes using SyntaxWarning with message matching r"^Layout of a constant includes a field '.*' that will be shadowed by the attribute '.*'$". 4. The Const class should support proper attribute access and indexing for various layout types (StructLayout, UnionLayout, ArrayLayout) according to test expectations.

requirement.description: View class has incorrect error handling for layout validation and field access. Tests expect specific error messages but get different ones, particularly for reserved names and field access.
requirement.contract: 1. The View class should validate layout types and throw TypeError with message matching r"^Layout of a view must be a Layout, not <.+?>$" when layout is not a Layout instance. 2. The View class should validate target types and throw TypeError with message matching r"^Target of a view must be a value-castable object, not <.+?>$" when target is not value-castable. 3. The View class should properly detect and warn about layout conflicts with attributes using SyntaxWarning with message matching r"^Layout of a view includes a field '.*' that will be shadowed by the attribute '.*'$". 4. The View class should handle reserved field names correctly, throwing AttributeError with message matching r"^Field '.*' of view with layout .* has a reserved name and may only be accessed by indexing$" when trying to access reserved fields via attribute access. 5. The View class should support proper attribute access and indexing for various layout types according to test expectations.

requirement.description: IO-related classes have issues with IOPort conversion and validation. Tests fail with "cannot be converted to an IO value" errors.
requirement.contract: 1. IOPort and related classes should properly validate that objects can be converted to IO values. 2. The SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes should accept IOPort instances and properly handle their conversion. 3. The Direction class should properly handle combination operations and validation with appropriate error messages. 4. The IOBufferInstance class should properly validate IO ports and provide correct error messages for mismatched lengths.

requirement.description: IR generation has issues with IO port handling and value transformation. Tests fail with "Cannot transform value" errors.
requirement.contract: 1. The build_netlist function should properly handle IO ports and their transformations. 2. The IR generation should correctly handle IO ports when building netlists, especially for IOBufferInstance and Instance classes. 3. Error handling for invalid port specifications should match expected error messages.
